新演化論可以說是我最推薦入手的桌遊之一，這遊戲我有實體版。

1.支援人數廣
新演化論支援2~6人，在2人局有如TCG對弈的刺激感，多人局則有混戰的娛樂性。很多好玩的桌遊都有人數需求，但演化論是各種人數都可以打的遊戲。

2.難度深淺自由選擇
如果是跟新手玩，可以只玩基本版，如果是和老手打，可以加入飛行氣候擴充增加戰略深度。

3.策略變化多樣
大方向可分為草食動物與肉食動物，但細分下去可衍伸不同組合，乍看下是很簡單的卡牌能力遊戲，但能引發的複合效應很有趣。
而且很重要的是，以生物演化為主題，只要是有國中生物水準的人，都能輕易瞭解遊戲在做什麼，各種奇形怪狀的動物插圖，也使這遊戲相當討喜。

備註：如果能揪到人，實體版值得一玩，揪不到人玩這個STEAM版亦可，遊戲畫面會因為戰況變化（旱地變草原，天冷變凍原），玩起來與實體版別有一番趣味，且有劇情模式可以挑戰，中文翻譯品質還能接受。

I bought this game years ago when I was in school. I was an original backer of the Kickstarter and I still love the board game version, but wasn't able to find many people to play it with since my family isn't as into strategy games as I am. This was the perfect solution, and I still have fond memories playing it in one of my classes after finishing the assignment and needing something to do!

However, I think it's worth noting that after however-many years, the base game seriously needs some free updates. Cooperation+long neck+forager slams any competition when set up correctly(and given the time the game's been live, most players have figured that out), but the cards that freshen the experience and help control the build the most are paywalled. I don't mind that Climate is a paid expansion given the additions, but since it's split the playerbase, it's made it harder to match with a player who has them.

I know the devs need money, especially for the Nobel Laureate art, but when there are less players(16 online on a Saturday evening) I find it hard to justify paying for a promo pack. Surely at this point at least ONE of the card packs could be added to the base game, or made an unlockable reward for a short period of time? Maybe the Arms Race pack that seemingly isn't available for purchase from the game or Steam page anymore?

The campaign was really fun, but doesn't appear to be getting any updates. AI play is also really fun, but gets stale after a while. Online play(when you can find people to match with) can also be fun, unless someone gets the magic card combo, and no DLC cards are in play, and none of the other players have the luck to combat it.

While I would recommend it to someone as a good game to play for a while, I'd also advise them to wait a bit until the base game gets some more love.
